availability: UTC date_utc is the daily bar open boundary. open records the first trade price within that UTC day, observed when that trade happens; exact first-trade time is not provided in daily klines. It is not known from the previous close and is not a guarantee of executable fill at the boundary.
execution_limit: Supports a conditional next-open price-reference simulation only. Does not establish bid/ask spread, market impact, simultaneous executable multiasset fills, liquidity, or latency. Keep current frozen close-based A/B results unchanged.
